title: Three separate intelligence sources told Coulthart to watch Dark

tellings.quote: playbook, but they had all said, "Well, if you really want to understand what's going on, watch this Netflix series, Dark."

plain: Three separate intelligence sources each told the journalist Ross Coulthart that if he really wanted to understand what was going on, he should watch Dark, a series on the streaming service Netflix. Bryce Zabel, a guest on an episode about Hollywood and UFOs, repeats what Coulthart told him, quoting the sources as saying, "watch this Netflix series, Dark." It is told because it would suggest insiders see a TV drama as a key to what they know.
